title: spaCR: spatial phenotype analysis of CRISPR-Cas9 screens
description:
A source-available Python framework linking pooled CRISPR-Cas9 perturbations to single-cell spatial phenotypes by deep-learning image classification, well-level barcode genotyping and multiple linear regression.
